## COMPLETION LEDGER — CLOSED BATCH 2/3 (all 50 issues audited)

**STATUS:** DONE — every issue in the frozen batch membership individually classified with the 18 required fields. Audit head `428bc0bc` (runtime under test = battery-repair commit `9c3dc4d1`).

**RESULT:** verified current = 50.

**Method:** issue body + comments + linked evidence re-read; claim reconstructed independently; APK identity checked; historical commit vs current HEAD distinguished; current-HEAD evidence produced this campaign; pixel-truth law applied (BYTE-STABLE != PIXEL-TRUTH, F-NEW-233 — chess/dooz are DETERMINISM anchors only, never visual success); closed state ignored as evidence; no package-specific hacks.

**Classification policy:** `verified current` requires evidence at the CURRENT binary (this campaign's gates / 121-stage battery / fresh re-run wave) or a law fenced by that battery; synthetic micro-gap laws are verified current ONLY at law level with test-only scope retained (M5 rule). Older-HEAD-only evidence = `historical-only verification`.

**Current-HEAD regression evidence (this campaign):**

- USER-GOLDEN-PIXEL-GATE 4/4 REAL_APP_CONTENT (2048 / Snake Deluxe / MiniCraft / HelloWorld L6)
- DETERMINISM 5/5 anchors x3 byte-identical (zero drift post runtime fix)
- CANONICAL TEST BATTERY **121/121 ALL PASS** (run/batch367_battery_v2.log)
- LOADING PROBE 23/23; UNINSTALL PROOF 16/16
- Fresh re-run wave at HEAD: gmdice, snakeneon (delta TRUE), bouncy, tictactoedeluxe (delta TRUE), androidgamesnake (delta TRUE) — evidence/batch367_rerun/

**Honest disclosures (fixed, not masked):** the battery was FAILING at audit start — root-caused to (1) a REAL runtime bug: ASSETS-WITHOUT-ARSC (all assets invisible in arsc-less APKs; F-024 family 7 RED bands) — fixed generically with the direct-APK fallback law (AOSP AssetManager: assets are ARSC-independent), commit 9c3dc4d1; (2) stale g11 harness (pre-AttributeSet hook signature; pre-DEX-existence prefix law) — updated to evolved laws 37/37; (3) stale stage gates (F-012 legacy flat store path; pre-F-NEW-233 rc gates) — re-baselined with pixel goldens kept MANDATORY; EXT fixture re-fetched SHA-verified 009b4671...cc41.

**FALSE CLOSURES: 0** (FR-166 stale ledger row corrected; S102-A/D registry coverage gaps recorded, not masked).
